_about: Assumptions for debt positions (debt.py). Every value here is an assumption, shown on the Credit and Integrated Stress pages; change it to see how much the results depend on it.
lgd_basis: Senior unsecured 45% and subordinated 75% are the Basel II foundation-IRB supervisory LGDs (BCBS, International Convergence of Capital Measurement and Capital Standards, June 2006, paras 287-288). Secured 25% is an assumption (F-IRB secured LGD depends on collateral type, 0-40%).
widening_basis: Assumed spread widening by rating category in a severe market fall (equity market -50%), scaled linearly by the scenario's market fall and capped at 1.5x. Used only for issuers not held as equity with Merton inputs; for those, the widening comes from the stressed Merton PD instead.
